name: slide-switch
title: Slide switch
summary: A hardware switch with two to four labelled positions on a short track.
use: For a mode that changes how something works, set once and left: output, quality, input source.
anatomy: Stops: a tick and a mono label each; the picked one in ink with an accent dash

options.name: orientation
options.description: Vertical reads like hardware; horizontal fits a row.

rules: One or two short words per position, uppercased by the label style.
For views of the same content use a segmented control instead.
accessibility: Exposed as a radio group; arrow keys move between positions and every label is a target.
